moves.text: Start Purdy over Bryce Young, and decide before 1 PM: Young's game locks then, three and a half hours before Purdy's
moves.why: Young (CAR @ NO, 1:00 PM ET) projects 18.8 vs Purdy's 20.72 (SF @ DAL, 4:25 PM ET); both are healthy on ESPN's injury feed. Once 1 PM passes, Young can't be swapped in, so if you have any doubt about Purdy, it has to be settled before 1 PM. On the projections, Purdy stays.

moves.text: Before 1 PM, check free agents for a D/ST better than the Vikings @ GB (4.96), dropping the Bears D/ST, not Mike Evans
moves.why: The Vikings' 4.96 is the lowest projection in the lineup, on the road at Green Bay (1:00 PM ET). The Bears are on bye (ESPN), so the second D/ST is a wasted spot this week. ESPN lists Evans (Achilles) as Out for DAL with a Nov 22 return date, so he's a Week 11 WR. I disagree with the Friday second opinion to drop him. The Vikings lock at 1 PM, so any swap has to happen before then. A 4:05 or 4:25 PM D/ST (SEA, LV, LAR, ARI, DAL) also works if added before 1 PM.
